description: Update an existing module's name, position or published state, and return the updated module object. Only the fields you pass are changed — anything you omit keeps its current value. Setting `published: true` publishes the module AND every item inside it (items Canvas couldn't publish come back as `publish_warning_items`); `published: false` unpublishes the module and every item inside it the same way — there is no way to change a module's published state without it cascading to its items. Use `get_module` to check the current state first, and `list_modules` to find the module_id. Requires instructor/TA permission to manage course content.
